notes.title: E-Startup 0.5.0 is available
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hi, 
[/b]
What's up ?[/h1]

There is not a lot of things because i got a new job, yeah ! So i release this version and i'm expecting problem like usual so please report them ! 

[h1]Shortly : New map, optimization, system and content improved , 32 bits available and i polishing the visual of the game. Website system isn't available for the moment because i'm working on a new one and price will up to 4.99 in a day.
[/h1]

[b]Thank for all players, peoples helped me and supporting me.[/b]

[b][h1][New MAP and plot !][/h1][/b]
A new map who will make you happy, you are now able to buy plot, small at the start and big at the end !!! Employees are coming randomly from houses. You can buy only one at time, when you move, plot and furniture are sells. Who will buy the biggest one first ?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32444211/5e936cf31b92f1431eb4724b53f9e6c43246b2d0.png[/img]

[b][h1][Building Mode][/h1][/b]
You can destroy all your floor with shift pressed on destroy click ! Wall Bucket is now fix and can paint wall side, 270 angle stopped bucket before ! Add content.

[b][h1][Wall Hide][/h1][/b]
Wall can be hide now, you have 3 settings, always hide or display or auto display by distance.

[b][h1][Multi-texturing][/h1][/b]
Multi-texturing is now available, you have a P key to active paint mode and select which furniture you want to custom if it's possible
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32444211/a73612903733c1824c48da5b0c27f1d2984c3af3.png[/img]

[b][h1][Micro-Management][/h1][/b]
You will be able to change the worktime ! Start and end of the day ! Also activate bonus to improve the mood bonus who make mood decline slower !

[b][h1][Salary and Jobs][/h1][/b]
Salary is now hourly, you have to paid at the end of the day the amount of hours spend at the work. Training cost one day now and more expensive. Items to generate have been added to the database.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32444211/b4af13d93f2363ee319bf3bd0b5d90d1c189c528.png[/img]

A lot of others things have been done, new musics and sound, algorithms changes to improve gameplay and minor changes visible on Trello: https://trello.com/b/dAmXoShm/e-startup-2019

notes.title: E-Startup 0.4.1 | Improved gaming experience
notes.content:
[b]Hi !
[/b]
The new update is available right now, I feel better to have finally been able to correct and add
what I wanted.

So in this update, no major addition of gameplay but a focus on the graphics and comfort of play and also optimization.

The arrival of the new characters who are moving! Now the doors will be useful and there is the elevator to navigate between floors!

[b]Construction menu[/b]

[list]
[*] - I destroyed the old models of doors and windows to make new ones, others will be added in stride
[*] - It is possible to rotate a door or a window, with the same touch of the furniture
[*] - The doors / windows are now paying!
[*] - The investment grid is now more precise
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]

[*] - The camera can now be moved up and down to better navigate the game.
[*] - Editing and adding sounds
[*] - Possibility to access the stock by storage shelves
[*] - Some notifications are now available by email
[/list]

There are a lot of small / medium details that I have not noticed, but minor fixes and additions, and I'm sorry I did not do that sooner.

In summary, this version brings a nice brushstroke to the game which will make your parties more enjoyable. Please report any bugs you find to patch me as soon as possible

[b]Why ?[/b]

I'm the only devs, i have a lot of work with the end of the school so i can't only focus on the game for this period.

notes.title: Controls and key
notes.content:
[h1]Displacement:[/h1]

-Z Q S D = Front, Left, Back, Right
-The mouse wheel can zoom in or out
-Press the wheel and move the mouse allows a rotation of the camera

[h1]Management of time :[/h1]

The numeric keys 1, 2, 3, change the game speed and SPACE pause or vice versa.

[h1]Various:[/h1]

Esc displays the pause menu

DELETE is used to interrupt an action in progress
